searches.query: latest research papers AI ML simplified
searches.answer: The latest research papers in AI and ML include "Idefics2" from April 2024, which improves OCR capabilities, and "Phi 3 Vision" from May 2024, the first multimodal model in the Phi family. Other notable papers are "SimCLR" from February 2020, a simplified framework for contrastive learning, and "Obelics" from June 2023, a web-scale filtered dataset. Additionally, "Dolma" from January 2024 is an open corpus of three trillion tokens for language model pretraining research. The sources also mention "Transformers Learn Low Sensitivity Functions" by Bhavya Vasudeva et al. (2025) and "Faster Cascades via Speculative Decoding" by Harikrishna Narasimhan et al. (2025) as breakthrough papers.
